title: Changes to Antigravity plans | Google Antigravity Blog

facts.fact: The Google AI Pro plan, priced at $20/month, provides an entry-level Antigravity quota for experimentation.
facts.quote: the $20/month Google AI Pro plan, which provides an entry-level quota for experimentation

facts.fact: Before this change, the Google AI Ultra plan at $250/month offered the highest Antigravity quota for use as a daily driver.
facts.quote: the $250/month Google AI Ultra plan, which offers the highest quota to use Antigravity as a daily driver

facts.fact: Google introduced a new Google AI Ultra plan priced at $100/month for users with lighter, regular development needs.
facts.quote: We are now introducing a new $100/month Google AI Ultra plan for users with lighter, regular development needs

facts.fact: Google reduced the price of its top-tier Google AI Ultra plan from $250 to $200 per month.
facts.quote: reducing the price of our top-tier AI Ultra plan from $250 to $200 per month.

facts.fact: Google combined separate Gemini Flash and Gemini Pro rate limits into a single rate limit that is drawn down according to API pricing.
facts.quote: we are combining these into a single rate limit, drawn down according to API pricing

facts.fact: Non-Gemini models remain on a separate fixed rate limit because of capacity limitations.
facts.quote: Because of capacity limitations for non-Gemini models, they remain on a separate fixed rate limit.

facts.fact: The $100/month Google AI Ultra plan has a rate limit of 5X the token volume of the $20/month Google AI Pro plan.
facts.quote: The $100/month Ultra plan has a rate limit of 5X worth of tokens compared to the $20/month Pro plan

facts.fact: The $200/month Google AI Ultra plan has a rate limit of 20X the token volume of the $20/month Google AI Pro plan.
facts.quote: the $200/month Ultra plan has a rate limit of 20X worth of tokens compared to the $20/month Pro plan.

facts.fact: The standardized multiplier ratios also apply during promotional periods when Google has access to excess capacity.
facts.quote: This ratio also applies during promotional periods when we have access to excess capacity.

facts.fact: Google removed AI credits from the base Google AI plans, and AI credits are now used solely as an overage mechanism.
facts.quote: Google is simplifying subscriptions by removing AI credits from the base Google AI plans.

facts.fact: For a limited time, Google is offering new and existing Google AI Ultra subscribers USD $100 in bonus AI credits for Antigravity that apply when they reach their plan's quota limit.
facts.quote: we’re offering new and existing Google AI Ultra subscribers USD $100 in bonus AI credits for Antigravity

facts.fact: The Google AI Ultra bonus AI credit offer expires on May 25, 2026.
Google Antigravity is now available to Google Cloud customers through Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
facts.quote: Google Antigravity is now available to Google Cloud customers through Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
